page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: "DE VERBORVM" with page number 128 at top left. Main text in one column of verb-conjugation tables with Latin and Italian/Latin forms set in lines, section headings "Futurum subiunctiui." and "Quando" as centred labels, then "Infinit.mod.temp.præf." and "Præt." as small labels. Catchword/fragment "Fu-" at the lower right corner. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Io haueréi, & hauería hauúto O Ego habuissem.
main_text.l: colúi hauerébbe & hauería hauúto ille habuisset.
coloro hauerébbono , & hauerìano hauúto illi habuissent.
main_text.head: Futurum subiunctiui.
main_text.p: Io hauerò hauúto Quando ego habuero.

page.notes: Text is partly faint at the right edge; some forms (e.g. "hauúro", "hauerānno") are doubtful. Catchword "Fu-" is at the lower right.
